_howTo: Wyclef's pins on the Notice Board. To swap one, edit it here (GitHub's web or mobile editor works) and the site redeploys. Fields: category (listening, films, tv, playing or reading), title, creator (optional), note (optional: why it is pinned), link (optional, a plain web address), pinned (the date, YYYY-MM-DD), feature (true for the one pinned larger; at most one).
